name: Þingvellir National Park
description: Þingvellir, about 40 km northeast of Reykjavík, is where Iceland's open-air parliament, the Althing, first gathered in 930 and met each year until 1798. Visitors can walk among the remains of roughly 50 turf-and-stone booths where lawmakers and disputants once camped. The site also sits in a rift valley on the Mid-Atlantic Ridge, beside Iceland's largest natural lake.
